Internship Interview Experience - Texas Instruments 
 
Name: Nishit Kekane 
Branch: Information Technology  
Batch: 2022-2026 
 
Details of Company: 
Name: Texas Instruments 
Location: Bangalore 
Stipend: 60,000 + Additional Relocation 
Roles offered : Software Development Engineer & Data Engineer 
Eligibility criteria : 6.0 +GPA & CS/IT Branch 
 
 
 
Flow of Selection Process: 
 
1)​Online Test: 6th Aug 
-​ Online exam was conducted in TPO under supervision 
-​ Lasted for 90 mins 
-​ Consisted of MCQ questions from Object Oriented 
Programming, Database Management System, 
Operating Systems and Computer Networks. 
-​ Generally questions were of easy to moderate level 
difficulty, based on the college syllabus of these subjects. 
-​ 2 DSA questions based on arrays and strings. 
-​ DSA questions were quite easy, doable with basic 
knowledge and practise.

-​ Shortlisting was mainly based on time taken so make 
sure you not only solve correctly but in minimum time. 
-​ MCQs had a greater weightage than DSA questions. 
-​ Make sure to have a stable WIFI connection before the 
test as it requires a minimum bandwidth requirement to 
begin the test which is not satisfied by the college WIFI. 
2)​Interview: 8th Aug 
-​ I was glad to have got shortlisted for the interview 
-​ Shortlisting is announced 1 day prior to interview , thus  
be prepared beforehand. 
-​ Interview was held in online mode on webex platform. 
-​ My interview was scheduled 2nd somewhere around 
10:00 am. (getting scheduled in first few interviews is 
always better) 
-​ Universal Question: Introduce yourself. 
-​ Be prepared with this answer.  
-​ Make sure your introduction does not exceed more than 
1 minute. 
-​ Include your name, education(CGPA if  8+), areas of 
interest and expertise, mention previous projects, 
mention participation in competitions such as 
hackathons or competitive programming, extra curricular 
activities in college & leadership positions held. 
-​ Speak about those things in which you are comfortable 
as the interviewer is likely to ask those things. 
-​ For eg: I spoke about solving 500+ DSA questions, 
problem solving skills , logical & algorithmic thinking as 
my strengths in the interview. Following which I was 
asked a DSA question in the interview which I was able 
to solve. 
-​ Again DSA questions asked were easy to medium level 
not so tough. 
-​ You are supposed to write, compile and run the code 
while you share the screen.

-​ Then I was asked about polymorphism & its types. Then 
I was asked to code and demonstrate Runtime and 
Compile Polymorphism. 
-​ I was asked to explain APIs , Rest APIs so be prepared 
with basics of Web development Principles as they are 
likely to be asked for the role of software developer. 
-​ I was given a scenario of the database and asked to 
write a complex SQL query. (It was slightly tough so I 
took some time). 
-​ We also discussed about the projects I had done 
-​ Along with technical questions I was also asked HR 
related questions. 
1)​Do you prefer to work in a team or alone and why? 
2)​After describing how I am a team player, they 
asked, describe a problem in communication faced 
while working on a team project. 
    -   At last they ask you if you have any questions for them?  
    -   Always remember to ask them questions as it shows             
that you are interested in working in their company. I had 
asked , on what projects interns are given to work at TI and 
what do you expect from an intern while joining them, in terms 
of technical skills.     
 
-​ By evening 8pm results were announced. 4 interns were 
selected out of which 3 interns were offered the role of 
Data Engineer and I was offered a Software 
Development Engineer position. 
 
Resources 
 
1)​https://takeuforward.org/strivers-a2z-dsa-course/strivers-a2z-d
sa-course-sheet-2/ - For solving problems 
2)​https://whimsical.com/operating-system-cheatsheet-by-love-ba
bbar-S9tuWBCSQfzoBRF5EDNinQ - OS

3)​https://whimsical.com/dbms-roadmap-by-love-babbar-FmUi8ff
Vop33t3MmpVxPCo - DBMS  
4)​https://whimsical.com/object-oriented-programming-cheatshee
t-by-love-babbar-YbSgLatbWQ4R5paV7EgqFw - OOPS 
5)​https://algo.monster/flowchart - flowchart is useful 
6)​https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLMCXHnjXnTnvo6alSj
VkgxV-VH6EPyvoX - System Design if u have time only 
basics 
7)​For DBMS and OS gates smasher’s videos are also very 
good. 
 
Tips 
 
1)Be confident 
2) While writing code during the interview make sure you write a clean 
code, within functions, with proper comments and spacing. Do not code 
as if you are giving a CP contest. 
3) Take the interview as a conversion dont feel overwhelmed by the 
pressure of the interview. 
4) Even if you are unable to answer a DSA question, give it a try and 
explain your approach.  
5) If you are asked a theory question which is out of your syllabus feel 
free to let them know but at same time try to answer with something you 
feel it is related to and assure them of learning about it post the 
interview. This shows that you're willing to learn things. 
6)Research basic stuff about the company before the interview like CEO, 
what is their primary business, Head Office, Offices in India etc.
